notes.title: New product "Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire"
notes.content:
Hello! This is ZOO Corporation.

Thank you for everyone who supports "Mahjong Pretty Girls Battle" and "Mahjong Pretty Girls Battle: School Girls Edition".

We have great NEWS here!
At the moment, we are developing a new "Pretty Girls" series, called "Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire".
And there is a screenshot during development here.

The game genre is "Mahjong solitaire".
It is kind of a puzzle game. Players take turns removing one tile at a time from a tower of mahjong tiles.

We are going to announce details of this game soon. Don't miss it!


皆さんこんにちは、Zoo Corporation です。

私たちの "Mahjong Pretty Girls Battle" と "Mahjong Pretty Girls Battle: School Girls Edition" を支持して頂いてる皆さんに感謝しています。ありがとうございます！

今回は、私たちの新作ニュースをお伝えします。Pretty Girls シリーズの新作"Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire"を開発しています。その開発中の画面を公開！
新作のジャンルは"Mahjong solitaire"、積み上げられた麻雀牌から牌を取り除いていくパズルゲームです。

ゲームの詳しい内容についていは、近日中に公開させて頂きます。お楽しみに！

notes.title: 【Mahjong Pretty Girls Battle】Bug Update ver1.0.1
notes.content:
As some users have noticed there were two issues reported that seem to have
occurred on systems with Windows locale setting other than English or
Japanese.  We are very sorry that these issues weren’t noticed before the
game was released yesterday and we apologize for any inconvenience.  The
development team has just uploaded a new version to Steam that we believe
should fix both issues.   Please let us know if you are still encountering
the same problem after completing the update.  Thank you for your patience
and understanding.



ある特定の言語設定で起動した場合、ゲームが起動しない・対局画面の表示が崩れるバグを改修しました。
皆様にはご迷惑をおかけしました。

何か不具合があればご連絡ください。

今後もよろしくお願い致します。
